content:
The 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León was the 33rd edition of the professional road cycling stage race held in the autonomous community of Castilla y León, Spain. The race took place from May 18 to May 20, 2018, and consisted of three stages.

Spanish rider Salvador Guardiola won the first stage, while Australian rider Benjamin Dyball claimed victory in the second stage. The overall winner of the 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León was Portuguese cyclist João Almeida, who won the final stage and secured the overall victory.

The 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León was part of the UCI Europe Tour and had a total distance of approximately 501 kilometers. The race featured a mix of flat and mountainous stages, with several challenging climbs throughout the course.

Overall, the 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León was a competitive and exciting race, showcasing the talents of both established and up-and-coming cyclists in the professional peloton.
